evidence.quote: While this expansion in lending must be prudent, on balance I consider this growth an encouraging sign of an improving economy.
In recent years, we have taken a number of actions to tailor supervisory expectations to the size and complexity of the banking organizations we supervise.
One such risk that the Federal Reserve has been monitoring closely is the reliance of some firms on potentially volatile short-term wholesale funding.
